resources.string: Checks each step between BooxUltimatum and Shizuku, including the helper service BooxUltimatum runs through it, and shows where it stops. It can take up to half a minute. If the helper service doesn’t start, the result also lists BooxUltimatum’s processes and the system log lines about Shizuku and the helper. Other apps’ names are left out. If a step fails, paste the result into a problem report.
